meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中通过 MCP 操作 Gmail 邮箱。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Gmail from an agent via MCP.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能使用 Gmail 的搜索、读取、发送、标签、草稿等工具，通过 OneCLI 安全验证，容器内不存真实凭证。
howto.when: 当用户要求与 Gmail 交互时触发，例如说“搜索我的邮件”或“发送邮件”。首次使用需短暂等待 MCP 服务器启动和令牌交换。

say.text: 搜索我的收件箱中上个月的发票。
say.note: Claude 会调用 search_emails 工具。

say.text: 给我的联系人发一封测试邮件，主题是‘Hello’。
say.note: Claude 会调用 send_email 工具。

say.text: 列出我所有的 Gmail 标签。
say.note: Claude 会调用 list_labels 工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Gmail tools (search, read, send, label, draft) via MCP, authenticated through OneCLI without storing raw credentials in the container.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks Claude to interact with Gmail, e.g., 'search my inbox' or 'send an email'. The first call may take a moment as the MCP server starts and OneCLI exchanges tokens.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for invoices from last month.
say_en.note: Claude will call the search_emails tool.

say_en.text: Send a test email to my contact with subject 'Hello'.
say_en.note: Claude will call the send_email tool.
Claude will call the list_labels tool.
